prompts.title: Roman Bust Image Prompt
prompts.prompt:
Photorealistic portrait of a classical Roman marble bust of [SUBJECT], carved in the veristic style. The face is rendered with hyperreal human detail — natural pores, deep forehead furrows, crow's feet, faint stubble — while the entire surface reads unmistakably as aged marble: fine craquelure, hairline fissures, mineral veining, and chipped edges along the shoulder. Thick sculpted hair. Head turned three-quarters, chin slightly raised, gaze directed off-frame toward an upper light source; expression resolute and severe. Draped toga carved in deep, heavy folds over one shoulder, fastened with a large circular bronze medallion embossed with a lion's head and a ring of Latin lettering; scale-armor pauldron visible beneath. Bust terminates on a round marble plinth at the bottom of the frame.
Lighting: single dramatic warm key light from upper left, deep chiaroscuro, strong falloff into shadow. Background is an abstract swirling nebula of dark umber and smoke, glowing faintly behind the silhouette, no architecture or horizon. Monochrome sepia palette throughout — burnt umber, bronze, warm ivory — heavy vignette, subtle film grain, low overall saturation.
Shot as if with an 85mm lens at f/2.8, shallow depth of field, museum-catalogue framing with the head in the upper third. Ultra-detailed, 8K, cinematic.
Aspect ratio 4:5.
Negative: color, blue tones, flat even lighting, plastic or CGI skin, cartoon, text watermark, modern clothing, full body, multiple figures.

prompts.title: Contours of Love
prompts.prompt:
Hyper-realistic 3D layered papercut and paper quilling sculpture, showcasing masterful papercraft artistry with a blend of matte and metallic paper textures.
Composition:
Symmetrical dual bust portraits centered in the frame. The male subject on the left and the female subject on the right face each other in close proximity. Their flowing ribbon-like forms merge at the base, elegantly converging into a refined heart shape that forms the lower structure of the sculpture. This heart-shaped base is seamlessly integrated into the design and gently rests on a minimal, smooth wooden stand (light natural wood tone, clean edges, gallery-style plinth).
Subjects & Styling:
Male (Left): Constructed from layered paper forms. Hair & beard (if present in the reference image) is styled in smooth, sculpted waves using thick silver metallic paper strips. His collar/outfit is formed from broad, flowing silver ribbons.
Female (Right): Constructed from delicate layered paper. Hair is an intricate quilled updo made from fine rose-gold metallic paper strips. Her drapery mirrors this style with soft, flowing ribbon forms.
Facial Detail:
Both faces feature subtle, contour-following layered paper cuts that define facial structure (cheeks, jawline, temples), enhancing depth and emphasizing the handcrafted papercut aesthetic.
Pose & Expression:
Clean side-profile views, perfectly aligned face-to-face. Their faces are inches apart, slightly leaning inward. Both subjects are looking directly into each other’s eyes, conveying a soft romantic expression with a sense of intimacy and emotional connection, without physical contact.
Lighting:
Soft, diffused studio lighting to enhance depth and cast subtle, realistic shadows between paper layers.
A warm, glowing backlight is placed precisely in the background between their faces, creating a soft halo and a focal point in the negative space.
Background:
Minimal, seamless matte off-white background for a clean, gallery-style presentation.
Camera & Technical:
Straight-on, eye-level shot, perfectly perpendicular to maintain the flat graphic profile while emphasizing 3D depth.
85mm lens, f/5.6, ISO 100, ultra-sharp focus, 8K resolution, high-end editorial product photography style, crisp detail on paper edges and layered contours.
Style Keywords:
papercraft sculpture, paper quilling art, layered paper design, metallic textures, minimalism, romantic symmetry, ultra-detailed, studio lighting, soft shadows
Aspect ratio 4:5.
No text, no logo, no distortion, no outfit from reference image.

prompts.title: Oak & Infinity
prompts.prompt:
Create a hyper-realistic 8K photograph of a highly detailed, intricately carved light brown oak sculpture made from a single continuous piece of polished oak wood. The sculpture forms a large elegant heart shape at the top that seamlessly flows into an infinity symbol at the base, symbolizing eternal connection. The wood grain must be natural and clearly visible, with smooth polished edges and fine carving detail that emphasizes craftsmanship and realism.
Inside the heart-shaped frame are two hyper-realistic wooden busts carved from the same light cream-to-light brown oak material:
• On the left: a woman whose face closely matches the uploaded reference image (face match enabled, identity preserved). The facial structure, proportions, age characteristics, and identity must remain accurate to the reference without stylization or alteration. Her hairstyle must also match the reference image correctly — if the reference shows short hair, the sculpture must retain short hair; if the reference shows long hair, it should appear as naturally flowing long hair consistent with the elegant carved style described in this prompt. Hair flow should feel naturally sculpted with realistic strand direction and depth, integrated seamlessly into the wood carving. She wears a carved cream beret and a ribbed turtleneck sweater. Her hands rest naturally together at mid-torso level without holding any object. Her facial expression is calm, soft, and natural, with delicate carving detail and realistic proportions. The facial planes, cheeks, and hands are slightly brighter and more evenly illuminated to enhance visibility of fine carving detail while maintaining natural wood realism. Her hair tone is slightly darker than the surrounding wood for gentle contrast and depth, and the lips carry a very subtle natural warm tint within the wood tone to improve realism without appearing painted or artificial.
• On the right: a man whose face closely matches the uploaded reference image (face match enabled, identity preserved). Facial proportions, expression, and identity must remain faithful to the reference image, maintaining realism and natural carving symmetry. He has naturally styled medium-length hair and wears a carved leather-style jacket layered over a high-neck knit sweater and a textured chunky scarf. His posture is relaxed and slightly oriented toward the woman, with refined facial carving and balanced symmetry. Secondary facial areas and clothing folds are softly brightened to preserve detail while maintaining realistic shadow depth. His hair tone is slightly darker than the base wood tone to enhance dimensional separation and realism, while lips retain a subtle natural tonal variation consistent with carved oak material.
Sculpture Base Design (Important):
The infinity-loop base is thick, smoothly rounded, and structurally integrated into the heart above. The sculpture rests on an oval wooden platform made from the same oak material. The names “Emily” and “Jack” are beautifully carved directly into the front-facing surfaces of the infinity loops, positioned symmetrically and naturally following the curve of the wood. The lettering appears as part of the wood design itself — elegantly carved, refined, and polished, with subtle depth and soft shadowing so the names feel handcrafted and integrated rather than added or embossed.
Environment & Background:
The sculpture sits centered on a smooth wooden table. A small potted succulent in a minimal ceramic pot sits to the side. The background is a softly blurred warm domestic interior with neutral beige tones, suggesting a sofa and window light, maintaining a clean lifestyle aesthetic.
Lighting (Matched to Reference Image):
Soft diffused natural daylight entering from the left side, creating gentle highlights along the curved heart frame and subtle shadows within the infinity loops. Lighting is warm, even, and cinematic, emphasizing wood texture and depth without harsh contrast. Soft ambient fill light maintains detail in facial carvings while preserving natural shadow gradients. No dramatic studio lighting — calm, realistic indoor daylight mood.
Camera & Rendering:
Eye-level composition, centered framing, shallow depth of field, ultra-photorealistic rendering, sharp focus on sculpture details with smooth background bokeh, premium product photography quality.
Aspect Ratio: 1:1 square composition.
